content.text: bisphos inhibit osteoclasts - USU drugs of choice for CA-assoc hypercalcemia; zoledronic acid 4 mg IV once ↓Ca avg > 40 days; pamidronate 60 to 90 mg IV once - repeat only after 7 days - ↓Ca ≤ 2 wks; repeated IV bisphos (bone mets · myeloma) → ONJ - renal toxicity w zoledronic acid; PO bisphos maintain norm Ca but ⍉generally used acutely; denosumab: CA-assoc hypercalcemia ⍉responding to bisphos - 120 mg SC Q4wks + extra doses days 8 & 15 of first mo; give Ca & vitD prn to avert hypocalcemia; calcitonin (salmon) 4 to 8 IU/kg SC every 12 h - ↓Ca 1 to 2 mg/dL w.in few hrs; in CA-assoc hypercalcemia, limited by short action w tachyphylaxis (often after ~48 h) & ⍉response in ≥ 40%. salmon calcitonin + prednisone may control Ca for mo in some CA pts

CI: hypocalcemia (must be corrected b4 starting Xgeva). CI: known clinically sig hypersensitivity to Xgeva or denosumab prod. Can cause severe Sxtomatic hypocalcemia w fatal cases - correct hypocalcemia b4 starting - monitor Ca esp first wks - adequately supp all pts w Ca & vitD. ↑ risk of hypocalcemia w increasing renal dysfun, MC severe dysfun (CrCl < 30 mL/min and/or on dialysis), & w inadeq/⍉Ca supp. Hypersensitivity rxns incl anaphylaxis may occur - d/c permanently if clinically sig rxn occurs. ONJ reported - oral exam b4 starting - monitor for Sx - ⍉ invasive dental procedures during tx. Atypical femoral frx: evaluate pts w thigh or groin pain to r/o femoral frx. Multi vertebral frx reported after discontinuation - when Xgeva = stopped, evaluate the pt's risk for vertebral frx. Hypercalcemia requiring hsp & complicated by acute renal inj reported after tx discontinuation in pts w giant cell tumor of bone & growing skeletons. May cause fetal harm - advise females of reprod potential to use effective contraception during therapy & for ≥ 5 mo after the last dose. Pts receiving Xgeva should ⍉ receive other denosumab prod concomitantly

CI: hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon or any excipients (rxns incl anaphylaxis w death, bronchospasm, & swelling of the tongue or throat). Serious hypersensitivity rxns incl fatal anaphylaxis reported - consider skin testing b4 tx in pts w sus hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon. Hypocalcemia w tetany (musc cramps · twitching) & sz activity reported - hypocalcemia must be corrected b4 initiating therapy. Meta-analysis of 21 trials suggests ↑ risk of overall malig in calcitonin salmon-treated pts. Circulating antibodies to calcitonin salmon may develop & may cause loss of response to tx. Use for Paget's dz or postmenopausal osteoporosis = recommended w adequate intake of Ca & vitD. Concomitant lithium may ↓ plasma lithium concentrations (↑ urinary clearance) - lithium dose may require adj. OD: hypocalcemic tetany could occur - keep parenteral calcium available for tx. MC adverse rxns: nausea w or w.o vomiting (10%) · inj site inflam (10%) & flushing of the face or hands (2% to 5%). ←the poss assoc b/n malig & calcitonin salmon use, the need for continued therapy should be re-evaluated periodically
